title: ClassSessionChanged
description: Hold ændret: a class session got a new start. Its reservations are kept. Published by Booking, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

classSessionId.description: The id of the class session. Consumers use it with startTime to handle the same event only once.

memberIds.description: The members who have a reservation on it (MemberId, from Membership); not the waitlisted. May be empty.

previousStartTime.description: When the class session started before the change, ISO 8601 with an offset.

startTime.description: When the class session starts from now on, ISO 8601 with an offset.
